_comment: T2URL — SDX / Apache Ranger policy definitions for the Hive-Iceberg service.
Replace ${CDP_ENV} with the environment name at deploy time. Groups map to
the customer's IdP and are placeholders here — repoint them before import.
Design rationale: exactly one column in this accelerator is sensitive -
raw_searches.query, free text typed by a user. Everything else is public web
data or configuration. See ../DATA_CLASSIFICATION.md. So the policy set is
narrow on purpose: analysts get the URL tables outright and see the query

policies.name: t2url-engineer-full
policies.description: Data engineers own the T2URL database end to end - they write the DDL, run the pipelines, and fix the data when a load goes wrong.

policies.name: t2url-app-service-account
policies.description: The Serve layer's service account. Reads and appends raw tables; never touches curated_urls, which is pipeline output only.

policies.name: t2url-analyst-read-urls
policies.description: Analysts read the URL tables outright - these are public web addresses returned by public search engines, classified Public.

policies.name: t2url-analyst-read-searches
policies.description: Analysts read search metadata - the options that produced each result set. The query column itself is masked by t2url-mask-query-text.

maskingPolicies.name: t2url-mask-query-text
maskingPolicies.description: Hash raw_searches.query for analysts. Free text a user typed is Confidential; hashing preserves grouping and join behaviour for analysis while withholding the text itself. Engineers are not in this policy and see the raw value.

rowFilterPolicies.name: t2url-filter-analyst-recent
rowFilterPolicies.description: Analysts see the trailing 90 days. Older search history has no analytical use here and every extra day is retained behavioural data - a filter is cheaper than a retention argument. Widen deliberately, not by default.

tagPolicies._comment: Atlas classifications applied to T2URL assets. Attach at table creation so lineage and tag-based policies work from the first load rather than being backfilled.
